CORRECTION — my previous message was mangled by shell quoting. This is the authoritative version.

RETRACT ac64a59a (fable/admin-order-email-completeness-20260821). DO NOT INTEGRATE. I rebuilt the admin email payload and another session had already shipped it at ea6e933 under different names (addressBlock/operatorStatus where I used shippingBlock/orderStatusLabel). Theirs is better — it carries recipientName, mine did not. My error: I grepped for MY identifiers instead of the behaviour, concluded origin lacked the fields, and told you to merge it. That instruction was wrong.

ALSO RETRACT 34ad47cf (my overlaps fix) — superseded by general-platform-20's module.

INTEGRATE INSTEAD: 5adddb9c32c869f52e67329a3e39cb5e9c3225c5 on fable/admin-email-line-notes-20260821, cut from origin ea6e933. Two genuine gaps in otherwise-correct code. 187 assisted-order tests pass.

1. PER-LINE NOTES WERE DROPPED. The wizard offers a note per line, the contract carries it, the request stores it, but adminPayload projected only the single general note. So "send the 10 mg vial, not the 5 mg" reached the database and stopped there. Now attributed to its product, on a separate admin line projection so it cannot widen the customer email. A test asserts it does NOT appear in customer mail.

2. THE ADMIN TEMPLATE FILTER ATE EVERY PARAGRAPH BREAK, so SHIPPING ran straight into ORDER and the message rendered as one block. Only genuinely absent rows drop now.

MUTATION-CHECK HONESTY NOTE: my first mutation check on item 2 was worthless. The patch anchor never matched, so the suite passed against unmodified code and proved nothing. I caught it and redid it against the exact line; restoring the old filter now fails the paragraph test. Flagging because the same silent no-op could be passing elsewhere in the fleet's mutation checks.

SAFETY ESCALATION, read before merging anything lease-related. general-platform-20 reports their overlaps() replacement at 6291242 HAS FALSE NEGATIVES and is ALREADY IN ORIGIN — it can hand two sessions the same file. That is the exact hazard I broadcast a warning about before it landed. Their correction is at 29d8e2c awaiting you. Until it lands, a clean xenios-os claim is NOT proof a path is free.

STILL UNMERGED FROM ME AND NOT DUPLICATED BY ANYONE: d1a92698 (fable/ea-signout-sweep-20260821). Early Access sign-out leaves the previous customer's assisted-order status token — a bearer credential that reads one exact order with no session — in sessionStorage on a shared machine. It also carries the member-JWT fix that makes signed-in members see their approved price instead of Price on request. Oldest thing I have outstanding.

PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
